name: barbell split stance rdl
description: A Romanian deadlift in a split stance, with most of the load on the front leg. It builds hamstrings and glutes and tests balance.
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
